author: Nuttyasafruitcake
title: Awesome App
body: Have been using this app for most of 2026 and I absolutely love it. I have quite a few watches and this app makes it so easy to keep track of everything about my watch collection. What watches am I wearing most frequently? Which watches aren't being worn as much? Which watches might be due for a service, which watches are coming out of warranty, when was each watch purchased, from what seller, how much did it cost? Developer is very responsive to suggestions from users and is actively updating the app and adding great new features. Really loving the app!

author: Zahir Poonawala
title: Makes setting autos easy
body: Excellent app to track watches, and makes it easy to set time on my autos using the time tab! Enjoying it so much that I bought the pro version!

author: Remmyj
title: Love this app
body: I can track the usage of all of my watches and learn a lot about how I’m using my 14 watch collection. With the addition of more information I can keep track of warranties, service dates, cost per wear and more. Highly recommend.

author: L Alexandre
title: Amazing for watch collectors
body: The app is amazing for watch collectors. It's very easy to use and upgrading has multiple options. Upgrading gives you access to a variety of advanced features like keeping track of lug width and water resistance. Never before have I seen as many charts about your watch collection as this app offers. I upgraded to premium because of how amazing this app is. It gives you an insight into your watch collection like I haven't seen before. The Dev is awesome too, and is open to feedback.

author: NotDavidR
title: Perfect
body: Exactly what I was looking for. Easy to use… from input to navigating. Lots of charts and stats for when I’m getting into my watch nerd mode. Absolutely love it.

author: Paul Breese
title: Cracking little app
body: Cracking little app for keeping track of what watches you own, wear, sell etc.

author: Khazandar
title: Must have
body: Ogni collezionista di orologi deve prendere questa app. Permette di monitorare ogni aspetto della collezione. Dal tempo indossato al valore. Un must have.

author: Sandy Hill
title: Simple, insightful stats
body: I love this app. Simple, but lets me know stats I'm interested in—examples are things like cost per wear and as you wear the watch more, you'll notice the cost per wear go down. Another one is how many times you have worn the watch this year and it will rank all the watches that you have. So all in all I love this app.

author: N8ivtxn6d9
title: Super Easy to Use!
body: Downloaded the app and within thirty minutes had my entire collection of (17) watches loaded in! Super intuitive. App is free unless you want to donate a couple dollars to remove ads. Highly recommend for tracking daily watch use.

author: Clare Larter
title: Best watch tracking app out there
body: So useful. Whether you use it just for tracking which watch you wear each day or use any of the other super useful functions, I can highly recommend this app. It's surprisingly fun discovering what I've worn over the days, weeks, months etc. IMO it's the best watch tracking app out there.

author: aceofbandits
title: Excellent
body: If you have a collection and would like a statistical breakdown of your wearing patterns I would recommend this app. It’s easy to use. There are ads but they are never intrusive or take away from your experience on the app.

author: Mark Shepherd
title: Made just for me
body: It's like this app was made just for me. I usually wear at least two watches a day and I love looking at the wear stats of my watch collection. It's also the perfect place to keep watch information like serial numbers, battery codes, purchase dates and any other relevant notes.

author: Agli amanti del cinema
title: Must have!
body: Great app, very useful for keeping track of all the watches in collection and for the track of the daily wear. Top!

author: James Fletcher
title: Essential for complex rotations
body: If you collect watches and have so many that your rotation is complex or chaotic, then this app is essential. Once set up it makes choosing your watch simple. The collected statistics can either help you ensure that no watch is overlooked or may indicate which watches should be sold.

author: FabFlow the first
title: Great for tracking watch wear
body: Perfect for tracking. Exactly what I was looking for. Thank you so much for the great app and your work!

author: Charles Pinney
title: Great charts and graphs
body: An excellent way to keep track of a watch collection. Each watch has sections for all the data (purchase date, price, serial number, type, etc.) one may want to enter. The visualization aspect with charts and graphs is also great.

author: Bsanli
title: Perfect app to track your wear stats
body: Just one word: excellent!

author: James Barwick-Snell
title: Seriously excellent app
body: Seriously excellent app. It doesn't seem to pester you to buy anything nor does it advertise at you. Just track your collection and see the data. I love the cost per wear stats too!

author: Lex Black
title: Best Tool for the Watch Enthusiasts
body: Love the new design.

author: James Akrong
title: Was already a great app
body: Was already a great app, but amazing after the latest updates. Developer was really responsive to feedback as well
